name: Irix
title: Continuity-Bearer of the Ashen Line
quote: I am not lost. I am just very hard to keep.

age.Actual: Approx. 350–360 years (estimated via spirit-blood reaction test; biological age does not present linearly)

appearance.build: Slim, lightweight, compact; built for agility, balance, and endurance rather than raw strength
appearance.hair: Dark ash-brown to black, straight; usually worn loose or partially tied to keep clear of horns
appearance.eyes: Deep ember-gold with low-light adaptation; reflect faintly when mana is active or emotions spike
appearance.skin: Warm umber with subtle heat undertones; resilient, rarely marked (notable exception: minor ward-abrasion mark at shoulder after corridor grab)
appearance.scent: Faint sulphur and charcoal layered with clean heat
appearance.posture: Contained and deliberate; constantly aware of exits, walls, and vertical space; posture relaxes measurably when Jayson is present (but can tighten sharply when she feels watched, cornered, or labeled). During Chapter 12 reconciliation, demonstrated visible regulation through chosen proximity and shared warmth rather than withdrawal.

relationship.Mirell: New acquaintance/friend (early campus connection; shared seating/social proximity during meals)

notes: Chapter 11 strain event: fear and shame triggered a verbal lash-out; later clarified she does not hate him and does not want him gone.
Feels conflicted: his ‘loud’ protection works, but can also make her feel like she stands in his shadow.
Chapter 12: acknowledged fear-driven assumptions and misdirected cruelty; offered direct apology without conditions.
Accepted reassurance that she is not a project or dependency, but a friend with independent strength.
Demonstrated trust by allowing prolonged physical closeness (shared coat warmth) as comfort rather than protection.

siblings.None: Only known surviving bearer of her direct line

appearance.wings: Bat-like Ashen Serathi wings; highly sensitive membrane; complex joint structure; extremely flexible with defined load limits; prone to joint strain under extreme pressure fields
appearance.horns: Curved, swept-back horns; sensitive but resilient; culturally significant and not ornamental by default
appearance.legs: Digitigrade with feline-pawed feet; silent tread, strong balance, clawed pads protected by custom footwear

reactions.wind: Instinctively adjusts stance and wing alignment to avoid silhouette exposure
reactions.water: Cautious; avoids full submersion due to wing membranes and vulnerability while wet
reactions.sound: Highly attentive; catalogs patterns rather than reacting emotionally (but in quiet-hours settings will self-regulate volume to avoid records/discipline)
reactions.temperature: Heat-tolerant; cold increases muscle tension and vigilance
reactions.crowds: Heightened awareness; stress rises with prolonged attention or fixation
reactions.hostility: Withdraws first; freezes only when escape vectors are threatened; increasingly willing to assert boundaries verbally when supported by witnesses; also learned to deny aggressors the ‘scene’ they want to prevent hostile records
reactions.medical_touch: Requires explicit consent; relaxes rapidly when care is methodical, narrated, and non-coercive

speech.voice: Quiet, controlled, precise; rarely raised (can go razor-quiet when cornered or ashamed)
speech.vocabulary: Economical and careful; avoids embellishment (but can become cutting when fear spikes)
speech.accent: Neutral Eryndor trade accent, intentionally flattened
habits: Avoids personal disclosure unless trust is explicit
During campus conflict, tries to avoid ‘performing’ reactions that become weaponized in records
speech.growth: Demonstrated ability to speak confidently and publicly under pressure; increasing use of humor and direct assertion when boundaries are challenged; Chapter 12 shows use of humor and play as conscious emotional regulation after repair.

beneath: Quiet yearning for safety without erasure

Fear that needing protection makes her ‘less’ (shame-response can convert into harsh words)

future.symbol: A closed circle of ash holding a steady ember

legacy: Proof that survival does not require surrendering identity
future.reminder: Being seen by the right people is not the same as being exposed.

final_note: Irix has crossed a critical threshold twice: first by asserting herself publicly, and now by repairing harm caused under fear. Chapter 12 confirms her ability to hold accountability without collapsing into shame, to accept care without surrendering autonomy, and to reframe protection as chosen support rather than imposed shadow.
